Stated Claim / Post Context:
Nebraska volleyball’s Andi Jackson named Big Ten Player of the Week for 2nd consecutive week

Nebraska volleyball’s senior middle blocker Andi Jackson was named the Big Ten Player of the Week for the second consecutive week, the conference office announced on Monday.

Actual Article Body:
LINCOLN, Neb. (KOLN) - Nebraska volleyball’s senior middle blocker Andi Jackson was named the Big Ten Player of the Week for the second consecutive week, the conference office announced on Monday.

According to Nebraska Athletics, Jackson’s all-around performance led the top-ranked Huskers to a 2-0 week at No. 16 Penn State and Maryland. Across the two matches, Jackson totaled 23 kills and hit .526 on 38 swings while adding 12 blocks on the defensive end.
